comments.author: LaurentMEKKA
comments.body_html:
Version 0.4.1 may be the last one, as all the features I wanted to add (or found interesting after user feedback) are now in.

New features since the first version

  • Gas masks & respirators let you stay longer, as requested.
  • MIA status when you lose to the gas (i.e. fail to extract), as requested.
  • Fully configurable through the F12 menu and you can add new gas masks via the config file.
  • English F12 menu and config file.

What I don’t want to do, even though it was requested

  • A gas analyser to see how much time is left. “Oh, I still have 2 minutes, I can keep looting instead of running” goes against everything I’m trying to achieve. Your extract time is already over, you should be dead. This mod is about running in fear, not about calculating what you can squeeze into your last 2 or 3 minutes.

  • Scavs taking gas damage. If I work on this, the request will evolve from “it’s illogical that scavs are unaffected” to “OK, now they take damage, but it’s illogical that they keep acting normally.” Following that logic all the way means rewriting scav behavior, which is well beyond the scope of this mod and would likely conflict with other mods. So I’ll pass on this one. Sorry!

And thanks to Cosm1c Gam3r for the playtest, I kept getting tarkoved during my latest tests, so I was unable to check the MIA status alone !
